title: Floer cohomology and pencils of quadrics
note: PDF library/arxiv-1006.1099v3/1006.1099v3.pdf — arXiv:1006.1099v3 [math.SG], stamped 13 Oct 2011; id year is the arXiv submission. The most directly usable paper of the cluster: §3.6 *Formality* proves higher products vanish by a grading/purity argument, which is the same argument `QOU/Mathlib/BarGradedCollapse.lean` makes for a spectral-sequence differential, and §3.5 *Grading and deformations* is that technique in the presence of a deformation parameter — the QOU situation.
